articles.title: Crypto campaign fund Fairshake faces $2 million setback in Florida primaries
articles.snippet: In a race that drew criticism to crypto's leading political action committee for featuring fake headlines in ads, Fairshake's expensive effort fell short.

articles.title: Most Americans say the Trump family’s crypto investments are not ‘appropriate’: Poll
articles.snippet: A new poll showed 63% of 1,166 Americans varied sharply along partisan lines, with a majority of Republicans saying it was appropriate for Trump and his family to invest in crypto.

articles.title: Flock's New AI Police Tool Can Track Drivers Without a Name or License Plate
articles.snippet: The underlying code for "OS Investigate" has 69 preloaded AI prompts that turn Flock cameras into a super-charged surveillance system that identifies people by how they move.

articles.title: Trump Calls on Congress to Pass 'Fair Version' of Clarity Act at White House Crypto Meeting
articles.snippet: Trump touted his administration’s crypto policies and said regulators are working to bring Hyperliquid into the U.S. under a compliant framework.
